Why the invite-link and forward methods are equivalent

Both simply resolve your private channel to its internal ID. Fast Scheduler stores that ID plus your admin status; the channel’s privacy settings never matter again after the connection is made. You can rename the channel, change its link, or toggle “slow mode” — the connection survives all of it.

Common questions
Can Fast Scheduler post to a private channel?
Yes. Private channels are connected by forwarding a post from the channel, pasting an invite link, or sending the -100 channel ID. The channel being private does not affect scheduling in any way.
Does the sender bot also need admin rights in a private channel?
Yes. The main bot needs Post Messages to verify and manage, and your sender bot needs Post Messages because it is the account that actually publishes every scheduled post.
How many channels can I connect on the Free plan?
Free includes 1 channel with 100 sent messages per month. Premium raises the limit to 3 channels with unlimited sends.
